problem: Determine the equation of the line that passes through the point $(-7,-9)$ and is perpendicular to $y=5.$
worked_solution:
Since the line $y=5$ is a horizontal line, a perpendicular line would need to be vertical. So, the perpendicular line must take the form $x=k$ for some value of $k.$

The perpendicular line needs to go through the point $(-7,-9),$ which has an $x$-coordinate of $-7.$ So, the perpendicular line is $x=-7.$
